to.name: Brian Swanson
to.program: California Geological Survey Regional Geologic and Landslide Mapping Program

subject: GIS data request — Jackson quadrangle PGM-19-01
body:
Hello Mr. Swanson,

I am working with the California Geological Survey’s Preliminary geologic map of the Jackson 7.5′ quadrangle, Amador and Calaveras Counties, California, version 1.0 (Holland and O’Neal, 2019; PGM 19-01). The preliminary-map page notes that digital geologic databases are available by request.

Could you please provide the Jackson source GIS database and its metadata? A file geodatabase, GeoPackage, or original shapefiles would all work. If available, I would especially appreciate the geologic-unit polygons, contacts and faults, map-unit description/lookup tables, and any symbology or correlation tables needed to interpret them.

The database will be used to display the published mapping with its full citation and to run a local, target-scale lithology and alteration screening workflow. I will preserve CGS attribution, metadata, and any use constraints that accompany the data.

Thank you,

[NAME]
